hero: An asymmetric fractured kilometre-scale glass 04 gate, with a hollow architectural silhouette, not a box.
focus: The cyan split at the right-of-centre threshold; the white rim is secondary.

layers.foreground: A partial near-black buttress cuts the left edge; refractive splinters pass the lens.
layers.midground: Fractured stepped decks, a metal spinal armature and the suspended lower gate.
layers.hero: Frosted glass arch, internal branching light and a single horizontal time fault.
layers.background: A distant 04 monument and three unequal relic fins in mist.

camera: Low oblique approach → slip sideways past foreground → accelerate through the opened threshold.
event: SPLIT / REVEAL / PASS. At 0.9s the judgement boundary lights; the upper arch freezes, lower arch separates; at 1.8s the camera enters the gap.
entry: The previous numeric nave becomes a physically refractive architectural edge.
exit: The opened glass threshold reveals distant architecture, then a hard cut flattens it into the following graphic geometry. No full-frame glass occlusion is claimed.
connection: 19.851–22.55s between numeric nave and exploded geometry; retain number + horizontal cut DNA.
palette: Cold smoke / near-black structure / cyan light seam. No rainbow.
physicalIdea: FRAGILE / FLOATING — hard refractive enclosure with soft tissue and dry trapped inclusions.

test: B: WATER × JUDGEMENT LINE × REFLECTION WORLD
hero: A thin water horizon separates an ivory impossible cantilever above from a violet aperture civilisation below.
focus: The white horizon; then the rotating violet world visible inside the film.

layers.foreground: A cropped submerged black shelf and refractive film edges.
layers.midground: Large fractured ivory cantilever overhead, broken dark terraces below.
layers.hero: Mirror horizon and the other world within it.
layers.background: Two continuous folded dark membranes enclose matte silver ribs in violet fog; a filled white aperture and far 08 silhouette establish the destination.

camera: Skim at grazing angle → dive through the horizon → roll into the lower world → accelerate into the bright aperture.
event: REFLECT / INVERT / ENTER. At 0.65s only the underwater world turns 90 degrees while the upper cantilever remains still; at 1.3s the camera penetrates the film.
entry: The preceding magenta membrane flattens into a physical horizon.
exit: White aperture fills the lens, matching the eight-frame white cut.
connection: 44.7–46.5s between organic membrane and white graphic attack; lower world borrows the aperture language, not the upper reflection.
palette: Ivory / ink surfaces; violet fog and magenta bounce light, white rim and exit. Saturation belongs to the air and light.
physicalIdea: WET / HEAVY / INVERTED — a water film reveals a violet civilisation with its own gravity.

hero: Five interlocking asymmetrical shutter blades inside a deep coherent fibre architecture.
focus: A white aperture at the tunnel vanishing point, revealed as the blades peel apart.

layers.foreground: Thick cropped metal fibres and one close cyan data strand.
layers.midground: Hundreds of tapering glass / metal fibres in organised helical depth bands.
layers.hero: Five-fold iris with a sharp, legible negative-space silhouette.
layers.background: A distant white aperture and hanging numeric cuts.

camera: Off-axis inside traversal → shutter opening → fast pass into the far aperture.
event: OPEN / PASS. The blades separate in 0.5s, fibres briefly contract, then camera passes the obstruction by 2.1s.
entry: The preceding warm vault is compressed into a dark mechanical throat.
exit: The aperture bleaches into the following scan attack.
connection: 51.7–54.8s before the cyan scan and four-frame black boundary; organic weight + hard mechanical timing.
palette: Near-black / silver glass / white aperture, rare cyan strands.
physicalIdea: TENSE / ORGANIC / MECHANICAL — bending nerves constrain a shutter, then release the camera into white light.

test: D: ROCK / TERRAIN × NUMBER MONUMENT × SKY
hero: The cracked surface of a floating continent forms the left foreground, framing a vast 08 monument beyond.
focus: The sky gap and distant monument, with a cyan embedded fracture guiding the eye.

layers.foreground: About half the frame is a rim-lit eroded relic slab with glass inlays.
layers.midground: Three unequal broken terraces and structural bridges inside the gap.
layers.hero: The continent edge and monumental 08 visible together.
layers.background: Blue-white sky, long distant beam and a second suspended landmass.

camera: Scrape close to the relic surface, reveal the number through its gap, then let an edge sweep to complete occlusion.
event: REVEAL / PASS / EXIT. The foreground crack widens, 08 is revealed, then a dark relic edge wipes the image to black.
entry: Match the preceding tiny black seed to an extreme close dark mass.
exit: Full-frame physical black occlusion, then the violet macro world begins.
connection: 39.3–41s connecting seed threshold to tissue world; makes black a spatial transition, not just an overlay.
palette: Blue-white distance / rough navy-black terrain / thin cyan inlay.
physicalIdea: DRY / DUSTY / MASSIVE — eroded continent skin becomes a wipe while a numeral becomes inhabitable space.

test: E: PROCEDURAL LIFE × FINAL DAWN × MASSIVE SCALE
hero: A tiny living fibre at the lens and a top-heavy suspended obelisk, split into three unequal inverted relic shards, share a thin reflective plane.
focus: First a warm rim on one near-black living leaf; then the cyan internal fissure in the massive suspended relic.

layers.foreground: A few large, close deep-green fibres; no grass lawn.
layers.midground: Fractured wet geometric platform with a few rooted fibres.
layers.hero: A hundreds-of-metres inverted obelisk with a jagged primary silhouette and two internal energy fissures.
layers.background: A second half-buried relic in cool haze and a thin judgement-line horizon.

camera: Centimetres above the water film; pass the close leaf, rise and reveal the gigantic threshold.
event: REVEAL / SPLIT. A leaf uncovers the relic; a cyan fissure expands while the horizon remains impossibly level.
entry: The island canopy resolves into a macro living edge.
exit: The obelisk edge becomes the next numeric monument.
connection: 12–14.591s between archipelago and macro leaf; revisited only as a small surviving sprout after final black at 135s.
palette: Cool dawn / near-black-green life / warm rims / one cyan seam.
physicalIdea: LIVING / ROOTED / SUSPENDED — close leaves penetrate an enormous weightless inverted relic.
